blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) has adopted a new policy framework providing expanded safeguards to migrant workers amid continuous prevalence of scam hubs in the region. In its plenary session on the 49th Asean Summit, the regional bloc adopted the Declaration on Fair, Ethical, and Sustainable Recruitment for Empowered Migrant Workers, Palace Undersecretary Claire Castro said on Sunday. Castro said the declaration seeks to ensure accountability and tighter regulations of recruitment agencies, prevent excessive recruitment fees, promote equal employment opportunities, provide protection and justice for workers, and strengthen international cooperation. “This was affirmed by Asean leaders […]...
